answer: The plume of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. The dawn lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the island is where a second reviewer recomputes them. The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, split across independent auditors, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work.
